title: opencode-hotkeys options
description: Options for the opencode-hotkeys entry in tui.json.

enabled.description: Set to false to keep the plugin installed but disable every shortcut.

preset.description: Base shortcut preset. Defaults to the native-first preset.

bindings.description: Per-action overrides. Keys are action ids such as hotkeys.new. Values are key strings, lists of key strings, or false to remove a shortcut.

debug.description: Write diagnostic markers to the OpenCode key-value store.
